description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 1095015507863 RACK,STORAGE,SMALL: Line 0001 Qty 12 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0110 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
